name: Write in-character dialogue for fictional characters
description: Users asked the assistant to generate in-character dialogue, reactions, or roleplay scenarios for specific fictional characters from various media franchises, often in response to user-provided prompts, fan fiction, real-world events, or hypothetical situations. Some requests involved original characters, public figures, or specific creative writing constraints such as tone, format, or continuity.
